Version 2.0.0 introduces a full rewrite, adding robust construction cost analysis and reporting features.

- Major rewrite and restructuring for clarity and usability.
- Skill now analyzes historical construction costs for benchmarking, escalation tracking, and estimation calibration.

- New data model classes (CostBenchmark, EscalationAnalysis, CostDriver) for clear and structured outputs.
